sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(TEXT2,1,3) AS EXP_CUR FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'CRCY' AND FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY EXP_CUR

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.EXP_CODE, A.EXP_CUR_PRICE, B.EXP_TTB_PRICE, B.EXP_DATE, CASE WHEN ABS(A.EXP_CUR_PRICE - B.EXP_TTB_PRICE) * 100 / A.EXP_CUR_PRICE > 3 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS WORK_FLAG, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY EXP_CODE ORDER BY EXP_DATE DESC) AS RANK, C.TEXT1 AS BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.TEXT1) AS COM_NAME_LOC FROM KEP_CURRENCY_HD A , KEP_CURRENCY_IF_LIST B , ICOMCOD2 C WHERE 1 = 1 AND C.TYPE = 'CRCY' AND C.FLAG = 'Y' AND C.TEXT2 LIKE #EXP_CUR#||'%' AND C.TEXT1 NOT IN ('KRKEPB0004') AND A.EXP_CODE = C.TEXT2 AND B.EXP_CUR = A.EXP_CUR ) WHERE RANK = 1
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO KEP_CURRENCY_IF_LIST A USING ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS EXP_DATE, #EXP_CUR# AS EXP_CUR FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.EXP_DATE = B.EXP_DATE AND B.EXP_CUR = B.EXP_CUR ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET EXP_BUY_PRICE = #EXP_BUY_PRICE#, EXP_SEL_PRICE = #EXP_SEL_PRICE#, EXP_TTS_PRICE = #EXP_TTS_PRICE#, EXP_TTB_PRICE = #EXP_TTB_PRICE#, STD_RATE = #STD_RATE#, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EXP_DATE, EXP_CUR, EXP_BUY_PRICE, EXP_SEL_PRICE, EXP_TTS_PRICE, EXP_TTB_PRICE, STD_RATE, CREATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), #EXP_CUR#, #EXP_BUY_PRICE#, #EXP_SEL_PRICE#, #EXP_TTS_PRICE#, #EXP_TTB_PRICE#, #STD_RATE#, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO KEP_CURRENCY_IF_LIST A USING ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS EXP_DATE, #EXP_CUR# AS EXP_CUR FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.EXP_DATE = B.EXP_DATE AND B.EXP_CUR = B.EXP_CUR ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET EXP_BUY_PRICE = #EXP_BUY_PRICE#, EXP_SEL_PRICE = #EXP_SEL_PRICE#, EXP_TTS_PRICE = #EXP_TTS_PRICE#, EXP_TTB_PRICE = #EXP_TTB_PRICE#, STD_RATE = #STD_RATE#, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EXP_DATE, EXP_CUR, EXP_BUY_PRICE, EXP_SEL_PRICE, EXP_TTS_PRICE, EXP_TTB_PRICE, STD_RATE, CREATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD'), #EXP_CUR#, #EXP_BUY_PRICE#, #EXP_SEL_PRICE#, #EXP_TTS_PRICE#, #EXP_TTB_PRICE#, #STD_RATE#, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
UPDATE KEP_CURRENCY_HD SET EXP_CUR_PRICE = #EXP_TTB_PRICE# , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE EXP_CODE = #EXP_CODE#
sqlMap.select: SELECT SUBSTR( XMLAGG( XMLELEMENT( COL, ';' , USER_NAME_LOC) ).EXTRACT('//text()' ).GETSTRINGVAL() , 2) AS USER_NAME_LOC, SUBSTR( XMLAGG( XMLELEMENT( COL, ';' , EMAIL) ).EXTRACT('//text()' ).GETSTRINGVAL() , 2) AS EMAIL FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT USER_NAME_LOC, EMAIL FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID IN ( SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'CR_MAIL' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT2 LIKE '%'||#BUYER#||'%' ) AND STATUS IN ('C','R') ORDER BY USER_NAME_LOC ) A
